en.title: Minimum Steps to Align Using Only Prefix or Suffix Increments
en.description:
Each step adds 1 to every element of any non-empty prefix, or to every element of any non-empty suffix. Turn source into target and output the minimum number of steps, or −1 if it is impossible.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line source, and the third line target. The original text had no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤n≤200000, with elements of both arrays in −10^9..10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 6, −1 and 2. Raising only the middle cannot be done with the allowed operations.
hints: Let d=target−source and let D be the sum of all adjacent decreases. If d[0]<D there is no solution; otherwise the answer is d[n−1]+D.
